reply.text: I'll help you build training around that. Let me pull up your current program and what you've been working on. Alright — no program running yet, so we're starting fresh. Here's what I'd build toward: a block focused on the legs and hips that ski season demands. That means quads, hamstrings and glutes work in controlled ranges, some single-leg stability for balance and uneven terrain, and minimal impact so your knees stay healthy going in. How much time per week can you train, and do you have a home gym or are you at a facility?
